entities.name: UniProt P47535
observations: The 244-aa query sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed Mycoplasmoides genitalium MG293 (UniProt P47535).
Annotated with phosphoric diester hydrolase activity (GO:0008081); exact substrate is not established from this evidence.
Associated with lipid metabolic process (GO:0006629); annotation evidence is computational/inferred.
Contains GDPD domain PF03009.24 at residues 10–224, consistent with glycerophosphodiester phosphodiesterase-like activity.
